data: Which of the following models is not represented in the graph?

The question asks which of the following models is not represented in the graph. From the caption, we know that the models represented in the graph are:

1. BERT-MLM
2. BERT-CF No control (TC)
3. BERT-CF (TC)
4. BERT-CF (CC)

Looking at the left graph, we can see lines representing BERT-MLM, BERT-CF No control, and BERT-CF. However, there is no line representing BERT-CF No control (CC), which is mentioned in the caption but not present in the graph.

Therefore, the model that is not represented in the graph is BERT-CF No control (CC).
